notes.subject: יחפשו/חפש/מחפש
notes.rationale: Three-fold repetition of root חפש 'seek/search': 'they search… a searched-out searching' — the verbal echo vanishes.

notes.subject: תמנו
notes.rationale: Read as perfect 'we have completed' (quote of the plotters, ASV) or as 'it is completed' — KJV supplies 'say they' to make it speech.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב rendered bel (inner self/mind-will), not the bodily organ lewa.

translation: Ol i painim ol pasin nogut; mipela i tok: 'Mipela pinisim ⟨пинис⟩ pain olgeta'; na bel insait bilong man na bel bilong wanwan i dip tumas.
